review_kind: author-team source review; not independent human review
scope: Reused source/learner/assessor selection and fixed-point contracts
Canonical source identity before and after extracted regeneration

initial_findings.finding: Initial producer compared only HTML/FIXED_POINT and original source identity after extracted build; other regenerated canonical inputs could differ.
initial_findings.fix: Fresh interpreter with cwd=extracted computes actual extracted canonical identity; verify_identity requires exact files mapping and aggregate equality. Added mutation controls for changed/new/deleted canonical files outside FIXED_POINT.

initial_findings.finding: Initial archive/log hashing inherited common.sha with whole-file read_bytes.
initial_findings.fix: Candidate-local sha now uses hashlib.file_digest; inspected regression forbids Path.read_bytes for archive hashing.

observations: No accept or promote call is executed by the inspected candidate producer; success/failure reports explicitly set accepted=false and promoted=false.
Selectors and writer are reused from package_v4/package_v5/package, including learner exclusions; actual source ZIP bytes are verified against returned entries and canonical identity before build.
Fresh candidate/extracted directories, pre-extraction member containment, and regular/unredirected source preflight preserve stated local extraction boundaries.
Actual extracted build runs with cwd=extracted; post-build selector runs in a fresh interpreter in the same extraction and its raw result/stderr/command are retained.
Exact HTML/file-set comparison, explicit generated fixed-point files, original source identity and all source ZIP inputs are checked after reproduction.
limitations: This review did not execute the full candidate ZIP creation or extracted-source build; those remain required final validation.
The repository owner reported Windows49 isolated release tests passing with6 symlink skips; this review inspected the four candidate guard definitions rather than claiming their execution.
No adversarial concurrent filesystem writer, arbitrary third-party archive, host security changes, independent learner assessment or physical observation is covered.
The shared ZIP writer still hashes individual selected input files via its established helper; the fixed issue concerned whole candidate archives/logs in this producer.
